response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, with notable strengths in C++ (7+ years) and leadership through mentorship and open-source contributions. However, his experience lacks direct alignment with the specific requirements for a Technical Lead in a cloud compute platform, including distributed systems, large-scale infrastructure, and cloud architecture. His recent roles focus more on full-stack development and AI-agent infrastructure rather than cloud compute leadership.
strengths: Strong C++ experience (7+ years) meeting the minimum qualification
Proven leadership in mentorship and knowledge-sharing (e.g., workshops, code katas, Refactoring Dojos)
Diverse technical background with experience in distributed systems (e.g., data integration team handling millions of HTTP requests/secon
concerns: Limited direct experience with cloud architecture and compute technologies (preferred qualification not met)
No explicit experience managing large-scale infrastructure projects as a technical lead
Recent roles emphasize full-stack development and AI infrastructure over cloud compute leadership
